transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well… they brought me in because of what happened at the fair. I was giving a talk, and I climbed up onto the tractor and started jerking the controls around, trying to show everyone this “new pattern” I had in my head. People were yelling at me to stop, but I just… I couldn’t make myself stop doing it.
Can you tell me more about what was going through your mind when you were on the tractor at the fair?

I was thinking I had to show them the pattern right then. It felt important, like if I moved the controls just the right way, they’d see what I meant. So I climbed up there during my talk and kept jerking the levers around. People were yelling at me to stop, but I just couldn’t make myself stop.
Can you describe why it felt so important to show people the pattern right then, even though they were asking you to stop?

Because I’m sure I’m the one who can actually prove this works. I mean, people around here keep doing things the same old way, and the university folks and the lenders, they act like I don’t know what I’m talking about. But I do. I know farming, and I know I’ve got a whole new way to grow things. So it felt like I had to show them right then, before they brushed me off again.
Do you believe that you have a special insight or ability that others don’t have, especially regarding farming?

Yes. I do. I feel like I’m the one farmer in this county who can actually prove a new way of growing things. The university people and the lenders, they keep doubting me, but I think they ought to be listening to me. I know what I’m seeing out there.
Have you ever felt that you have a unique understanding or insight that others refuse to believe, even when they say there’s no evidence for it?

Yes. Even when my wife shows me the lender’s paperwork and says it’s all plain as day, I don’t see it that way. I look at the yield maps and the drone reports, and those odd numbers stand out. To me they’re not random. They’re warnings, like somebody’s trying to take the farm out from under me and they’ve coded it in there.
Do you often feel that others are conspiring against you or trying to interfere with your work, even if there’s no clear proof?

Yes, I do. I know people say there’s no clear proof, and my wife points to the lender’s paperwork like it’s just normal business. But when I look at the yield maps and those drone reports, those odd numbers don’t look random to me. They look like coded warnings, like folks are trying to take the farm out from under me.

When you see those odd numbers in the yield maps and drone reports, do you ever feel like you're noticing something that isn't actually there, or do you believe it's something hidden that others are just not seeing?

I don’t think I’m making it up. I believe there’s something hidden in those numbers that other people are missing. Even when my wife lays out the lender’s papers and says it’s straightforward, I still see those odd numbers in the yield maps and drone reports as coded warnings—like people are trying to take the farm away from me.
Have you ever seen, heard, or sensed something that others around you didn’t seem to notice, like voices, images, or other sensations?

Yes. Out by the north pasture, mostly near dusk, I hear voices coming through the irrigation lines. They sound clear to me, telling me which rows are poisoned or which ones are blessed. Other folks don’t seem to hear it, but I do. And it still happens even on weeks when I’m not all fired up or worked up.
Do you hear those voices through the irrigation lines even when you’re not feeling particularly stressed or worked up?

Yes. There were quieter weeks where I wasn’t especially wound up or feeling big or anything like that, and I still heard the irrigation lines talking. And I still felt like the farm data had hidden warnings in it.
Do you believe, even now, that the voices you hear through the irrigation lines or the warnings you see in the data are part of a real and true reality, even if others say it’s not real?

Yes. I know other people say it’s not real, but to me it is. Even when my wife shows me the lender’s paperwork and says it’s all plain, I still know those odd numbers in the yield maps and drone reports are warnings. They’re coded, like folks are trying to take the farm out from under me.
How long have you believed that the numbers in the farm data contain hidden warnings and that the irrigation lines carry voices speaking to you?
It’s been about 11 months now, I’d say. Not quite a full year, but close. The voices in the lines and the numbers looking like warnings started around then and just kept going.
Have you ever had a period of time when you felt unusually energetic, needed less sleep, or felt like your thoughts were racing, where your behavior was noticeably different from your usual self?

Yes, I’ve had stretches like that. I get going way harder than normal—like I’ll start fixing fence, then jump to recalibrating the sprayer, then start calling suppliers before breakfast. By noon I’ve got five more jobs started than any crew could reasonably finish. It’s noticeably different from how I usually work.
How long did you feel unusually energetic, had less need for sleep, or felt your thoughts were racing during those noticeably different periods?

Those periods have been going on for most of the past year… I’d say about 10 months or so altogether. It’s been a long stretch of feeling charged up, not sleeping much, and my thoughts just not slowing down.
